title: Amal and the Returning Voice
logline: Amal calls into the world and learns that every voice comes home.
story: At the rim of the great valley where Ghassan, who was the vigor of youth, was said to dwell, Amal — carrying hope, concentrated light — shouted a harsh word into the dark, and a harsh word came back; then Amal shouted a kind one, and kindness returned. For a long while Amal only listened to the echoes, learning their quiet law. By dusk Amal understood that the valley had never invented a single sound — it had only returned what was given. Amal walked home speaking gently, knowing the world was an honest mirror.
moral: Whatever you send into the world returns to you; the world keeps no other ledger.
